task_description: Investigate issue #7597: fleet_probe.py reported at 14.8% failing the per-file coverage floor. Determine whether the file is genuinely undertested (remedy: add tests) or whether the reading is a CI coverage-arm truncation artifact (remedy: documented investigation, no test-writing, no baseline entry). Produce a written investigation report grounded in codebase evidence, plus assess the separate CI-policy suggestion about running Coverage Gate on pushes to main.

verification.summary: Diagnostic/docs task: no product code changed, so build/test/docker are not applicable. All report citations spot-checked against the tree and correct: TestFleetProbe at test/test_pipeline_conductor_agent.py:179 (loader :181, SKILL_DIR :26, 20 test_* methods), TestCreditSpend control case at :453, ci.yml on:push+pull_request at 3-6, concurrency 11-19, coverage-combine downloads coverage-shard-* with merge-multiple:true and no all-shards-present assertion. Empirical coverage measurement was blocked by INTEGRATIONS_ONLY (coverage/pytest_cov absent, no PyPI); disposition reached by static analysis. test_quality=pass reflects that no tests were added by design (existing TestFleetProbe already covers the file).
